integrity: Exact elementary polynomial proof and separately implemented direct quandle-square enumerations; all documented tests passed. The counterexample to the literal scope of arxiv:2608.01550 Theorem 3.6 is a computation in F9[R3], independently expressible in three multiplication equations.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime dihedral quandle order and matching characteristic only; no classification of composite-order or nonmatching-characteristic cases. The later 2026 preprints arxiv:2609.03799 and arxiv:2610.08204 were available only in abstract, leaving overlap risk. Direct finite checks corroborate an infinite symbolic proof but do not provide independent certification.
title: Modular idempotent resonance in prime dihedral quandle algebras
